title: Service and modification history
intro: Released completed work only. No former-owner details.
loading: Reading current permission and released work…
empty: No released completed work is recorded.
denied: Access denied. Sign in with the permitted account or ask for current record access.
pending: Completion is pending. The responsible record operator must resolve the source record; retry this reference later.
unavailable: History is unavailable. Retry the same request or contact support with its reference.
stale: The record changed. Review the current revision and request it again.
invalid: Enter a valid watch reference and a whole record revision.
aftercare: Aftercare references this original job; entitlement requires a separate review.
withdraw: Publish an empty selection to withdraw all records. Only the current owner may publish.
published: The selected safe records are published.
publishing: Publication is pending. Retry the same reference.
